## 24d677c76640

**A1: Reproduced in-domain lesson ambiguity, not a Racket label mismatch.**
Generator SHA: `b1b72a55d26ced9e90bee2fd0f250f2bd673c751a1c4ba9db845232a47c2efbd`.
Raw rule SHA: `75dd7655617e8d8f5e815ce1d68efc8c9daa522286d3d8b3df9823696a3b21af`.

Intended: align the nonblue object's bounding-box top-left with its blue anchor.
Rival: align its first row-major occupied cell with the anchor. These are equal
when the bounding-box top-left is occupied. The rival fits the two canonical
training pairs but **fails the canonical labeled test**, so it is not called a
shortcut fitting all canonical pairs. Actual Racket matches all three pairs.

Seed20, difficulty easy, sample indices0,1,2 as demos and3 as query, no overrides,
is an exact ambiguous generated episode. All three demo labels agree with the
rival; query shape is a plus whose upper-left box cell is empty. Reference and
rival differ by one column. Target validator returns no errors; input belongs
to the documented generator domain. Full demos/query/Racket/rival values and
reproducer are in
`checks/counterexamples/audit_24d677c76640_counterexample.json`.

Measured seeds0..99, indices0..3, three bands: 1,200 draws /1,178 unique inputs,
300 nonoverlapping-per-seed three-demo lessons, **12 ambiguous lessons**.
All12 are retained, not just the first. No generated validation or mirror-vs-
Racket failure was found. An additional 384 forced cases cover all12 shapes,
all8 anchor directions and all four height/width boundary combinations 7/12,
at seed17,index4,medium: no axis, validator or parity failure. The audit's lesson
contract is explicitly three demos because this target declares no
EXAMPLES_NEEDED. A consumer using a different episode policy must remeasure.

Suggested repair, not applied: schedule at least one empty-bbox-corner shape
among demos or use a lesson-identifiability gate. Merely increasing shape variety
can increase ambiguous query exposure without making the demonstrations decisive.
